calle_noche.texto: Quiet city street corner at 2 AM after rain, distant traffic hum, light dripping water, no music, no voices

comal.texto: Close-up of beef and chorizo frying on a street taco griddle: crackling fat, irregular pops and spatters, a metal spatula scraping now and then, warm and greasy, no steady hiss, no music, no voices

cuchillo.texto: Knife chopping meat quickly on a wooden cutting board, several fast chops

foco_zumbido.texto: Low 60 hertz electrical hum of an old light bulb, deep and soft, low frequency only, no hiss

taxi_llega.texto: Old car approaching slowly on a wet street, braking and stopping, engine idling then turned off

puertas_auto.texto: Three car doors opening and closing one after another

perro_ladra.texto: Medium street dog barking a few times, outdoors at night

perro_grune.texto: Dog growling low and whining, then backing away

goteo.texto: Water dripping steadily from wet clothes onto pavement, close

apagon.texto: Power outage: electrical hum suddenly cuts off with a soft click, then silence

perilla_gas.texto: Turning a gas stove knob off, flame goes out with a soft whoosh

respiracion.texto: Slow heavy breathing of something unseen in the dark, close, wet and raspy, creepy

luz_vuelve.texto: Electrical power coming back on, a click and a bulb buzzing back to life

pasos.texto: Slow footsteps of one person walking on a wet sidewalk at night

cola_perro.texto: Happy dog whimpering softly and tail thumping

golpe_titulo.texto: Deep cinematic impact boom for horror trailer, short

dron.texto: Dark low horror drone, slowly rising tension, no melody

latidos.texto: Slow deep human heartbeat, close and muffled, steady
